observations: Fitted glove surface and 39-bone names/hierarchy are reusable technical/reference inputs.
Below the narrow exposed wrist band, the full forearm surface is folded fabric with jacket cuff, tab and closed sleeve end; there is no anatomical forearm underneath.
Removing the sleeve leaves no elbow-to-wrist bare anatomy. Recoloring, smoothing or using a cylinder would not meet the requested anatomical change.
decision: Reuse compatible rig structure/naming and glove design; clean complete geometry reuse is insufficient. Use the single reserved draft for a coherent right gloved hand with bare forearm. Preserve ART-19 unmodified.
